jobs.title: Sales Specialist Panel Builder (80 - 100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

EL Product Marketing Manager

__

Your Role

In this dynamic sales position, you will drive market development with panel builders across the northwestern region of German-speaking Switzerland. You will identify market opportunities, build strong customer relationships, and successfully position our electrical power distribution solutions. Working closely with internal teams, sales partners, and key stakeholders, you will directly contribute to sustainable business growth.

Work model: Hybrid

This role is part of the Electrification, Smart Power Division in Baden, Aargau, Switzerland.

Your • Responsibilities

  • Achieve sales targets by identifying new market opportunities, building a sustainable sales pipeline in Salesforce, and developing targeted business strategies.
  • Manage customer projects from opportunity identification through successful closure, developing tailored technical and commercial solutions together with internal teams and partners.
  • Foster long-term partnerships through proactive needs identification, expert consultation, and excellent customer service throughout the entire sales cycle.
  • Coordinate all relevant stakeholders and ensure professional sales processes through clear communication regarding lead times, commercial terms, and contractual conditions.

Your Background

  • Several years of successful experience in technical sales or project sales, ideally within switchgear, power distribution, or building technologies, with a proven track record of delivering results.
  • Technical background with a relevant degree, diploma, or vocational qualification in electrical engineering, power distribution, or a related field.
  • Ability to navigate complex sales processes and communicate effectively with decision-makers at all organizational levels.
  • Demonstrated strength in building sustainable customer relationships through a partnership-oriented approach.
  • Strategic consulting skills related to business models, market positioning, and competitive differentiation.
  • Structured, solution-oriented working style with strong prioritization skills and adaptability in dynamic environments.
  • Languages: Native French speaker required; German language skills are an advantage. Additional languages are welcome.Valid Category B driving license and legal authorization to work in Switzerland.

Benefits

  • • We offer our employees a range of attractive benefits, including:
  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan (ESAP)
  • REKA vouchers
  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Enhanced parental leave program
  • Fitness allowance
  • Company car

About Us

ABB Smart Buildings enhances energy efficiency, safety, and comfort across all types of buildings through innovative digital technologies and integrated solutions. We serve a wide range of markets, from residential homes to industrial facilities, with scalable solutions that deliver both sustainability and financial benefits while supporting carbon reduction strategies.


This recruitment is led by Reto Korstick, Talent Partner, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Mechanical Supervisor (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Team Leader

__

As a Mechanical Site Supervisor, you will represent ABB at customer sites in the mining industry. You will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and supervising all mechanical work related to the installation and maintenance of ABB Gearless Mill Drives (GMD). This includes leading on-site teams, ensuring compliance with safety and quality standards, and acting as the key technical liaison between ABB and the customer.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Process Industries division in Switzerland.

• Your responsibilities

  • Supervise mechanical maintenance and installation activities for GMD at customer sites. Coordinate mechanical work based on project scope, site conditions, and available resources.

  • Enforce ABB’s EHS (Environment, Health, and Safety) policies and conduct safety briefings before work begins and guide and support local mechanics, welders, and helpers in executing tasks safely and efficiently.

  • Ensure all work is performed according to the latest technical documentation and ABB quality standards. Additionally, identify and report technical discrepancies in drawings or documentation.

  • Participate in site meetings with customers, contractors, and ABB teams as well as prepare clear and accurate service and installation reports.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Completed apprenticeship as an industrial or mechanical technician/engineer.

  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in mechanical site work, preferably in mining, heavy industry or power plants.

  • Strong technical understanding of mechanical systems; knowledge of ABB GMD systems is an advantage.

  • Fluent in English; Spanish is a plus.

  • Willingness to travel globally on short notice, including weekends and public holidays.

  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and instructions in English.

  • Strong teamwork, leadership, and communication skills.

More about us
Process Industries division delivers complete electrification and automation solutions, industry-specific products, and lifecycle services across industries. Engineering and delivering automation solutions from device to monitoring and control make our customers get more out of their investment; digitalization solutions including collaborative operations and augmented reality to help improve plant and enterprise productivity, reduce maintenance and energy costs. Our engineering, project management, services and solutions portfolio covers a wide range of industries – Mining, Pulp & Paper, Metals, Aluminum and Cement, and Food and Beverage.

The recruiting process is led by Ceren Oezen, Talent Partner ABB Switzerland Ltd.

jobs.title: R&D Center Lead - Materials Development (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Global Unit Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to lead the cross-regional Materials Development competency and make materials technology a source of product performance, compliance, sustainability, cost competitiveness and innovation. The role owns material technology platforms, qualification and risk governance, supplier collaboration and materials roadmaps, and manages the Materials Laboratory in Uster, including its pathway toward recognized accreditation for selected methods.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the ELIP. Main stakeholders are R&D leadership, Product Management, Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain Management.

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Lead the cross-regional Materials Development competency, defining technology strategy across polymers, elastomers, metals, alloys and coatings.
  • Develop and manage the Materials Laboratory in Uster, ensuring safe operations, technical excellence and future accreditation capabilities.
  • Drive material innovation, sustainability and compliance, including new materials, qualifications, failure analysis and risk management.
  • Support the delivery of new products by ensuring material solutions meet performance, quality, certification, timing and cost requirements.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing team, building competencies, succession plans and cross-regional collaboration.
  • Build strong partnerships with Product Management, Operations, suppliers, universities and research organizations to accelerate innovation and growth.

• Qualifications for the role

  • 10+ years of experience in materials development, qualification or testing in industrial products
  • Strong knowledge of polymers, elastomers, thermoplastics, metals, alloys and coatings
  • Experience in material testing, failure analysis and compliance (REACH/RoHS)
  • Proven experience leading technical teams and cross-functional projects
  • Experience in laboratory environments and quality management
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Polymer Engineering, Chemistry or related field
  • Fluent German and English

More about us

ABB Installation Products Division (formerly Thomas&Betts), helps manage the connection, protection and distribution of electrical power from source to socket. The Division’s products are engineered to provide ease of installation and perform in demanding and harsh conditions, helping to ensure safety and continuous operation for utilities, businesses and people around the world. The Commercial Essentials product segment includes electrical junction boxes, commercial fittings, strut and cable tray metal framing systems for commercial and residential construction. The Premier Industrial product segment includes multiple product lines, such as Ty-Rap® cable ties, T&B Liquidtight Systems® protection products, PVC coated and nylon conduit systems, power connection and grounding systems, and cable protection systems of conduits and fittings for harsh and industrial applications. The Division also manufactures solutions for medium-voltage applications used in the utility market under its marquee brands including Elastimold™ reclosers and switchgear, capacitor switches, current limiting fuses, Homac™ distribution connectors, Hi-Tech Valiant™ full-range current limiting fuse for fire mitigation, faulted current indicators and distribution connectors, cable accessories and apparatus with products for overhead and underground distribution. Manufacturing includes made-to-stock and custom-made solutions.

R&D Global Unit Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to lead the cross-regional Materials Development competency and make materials technology a source of product performance, compliance, sustainability, cost competitiveness and innovation. The role owns material technology platforms, qualification and risk governance, supplier collaboration and materials roadmaps, and manages the Materials Laboratory in Uster, including its pathway toward recognized accreditation for selected methods.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the ELIP. Main stakeholders are R&D leadership, Product Management, Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain Management.

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Lead the cross-regional Materials Development competency, defining technology strategy across polymers, elastomers, metals, alloys and coatings.
  • Develop and manage the Materials Laboratory in Uster, ensuring safe operations, technical excellence and future accreditation capabilities.
  • Drive material innovation, sustainability and compliance, including new materials, qualifications, failure analysis and risk management.
  • Support the delivery of new products by ensuring material solutions meet performance, quality, certification, timing and cost requirements.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing team, building competencies, succession plans and cross-regional collaboration.
  • Build strong partnerships with Product Management, Operations, suppliers, universities and research organizations to accelerate innovation and growth.

• Qualifications for the role

  • 10+ years of experience in materials development, qualification or testing in industrial products
  • Strong knowledge of polymers, elastomers, thermoplastics, metals, alloys and coatings
  • Experience in material testing, failure analysis and compliance (REACH/RoHS)
  • Proven experience leading technical teams and cross-functional projects
  • Experience in laboratory environments and quality management
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Polymer Engineering, Chemistry or related field
  • Fluent German and English

More about us

ABB Installation Products Division (formerly Thomas&Betts), helps manage the connection, protection and distribution of electrical power from source to socket. The Division’s products are engineered to provide ease of installation and perform in demanding and harsh conditions, helping to ensure safety and continuous operation for utilities, businesses and people around the world. The Commercial Essentials product segment includes electrical junction boxes, commercial fittings, strut and cable tray metal framing systems for commercial and residential construction. The Premier Industrial product segment includes multiple product lines, such as Ty-Rap® cable ties, T&B Liquidtight Systems® protection products, PVC coated and nylon conduit systems, power connection and grounding systems, and cable protection systems of conduits and fittings for harsh and industrial applications. The Division also manufactures solutions for medium-voltage applications used in the utility market under its marquee brands including Elastimold™ reclosers and switchgear, capacitor switches, current limiting fuses, Homac™ distribution connectors, Hi-Tech Valiant™ full-range current limiting fuse for fire mitigation, faulted current indicators and distribution connectors, cable accessories and apparatus with products for overhead and underground distribution. Manufacturing includes made-to-stock and custom-made solutions.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Marketing & Sales Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a sales environment by supporting initiatives focused on data understanding, structuring, analysis, and automation. You will work closely with the sales team to understand how commercial and technical information is generated, stored, and used across different systems, and help identify opportunities to improve efficiency through digitalization and automation.

The work model for the role is: #-LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Analyzing data sources used by the sales organization, including offer documentation, SharePoint repositories, internal sales tools, and CRM systems such as Salesforce.

  • Understanding how commercial, pricing, business, and technical information is created, managed, and used across the sales process.

  • Identifying opportunities to structure data more effectively and support the development of automated workflows, dashboards, or analytical modules to improve team efficiency.

  • Collaborating with sales and other relevant stakeholders to document current practices, propose improvements, and support implementation of data-driven solutions.


• Qualifications for the role

  • You are currently pursuing, or have recently completed, a Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.

  • You have strong interest in data analysis, artificial intelligence, automation, and the optimization of business processes through digital solutions.

  • You have practical knowledge of programming and data handling tools, preferably Python; familiarity with C#, databases, or API-based integrations is a plus.

  • You are comfortable working with large and unstructured datasets from different business systems and translating them into structured insights and improvement ideas.

  • You have an analytical mindset and enjoy understanding how information flows through business processes, from generation to reporting and decision-making.

  • You communicate clearly in English; additional language skills such as German are a plus.

  • You hold a valid work permit for Switzerland or are eligible to work in Switzerland.

More about us

Process Industries division delivers complete electrification and automation solutions, industry- specific products and lifecycle services across industries. Understanding and addressing challenges and opportunities take a deep domain knowledge. Engineering and delivering automation solutions from device to monitoring and control make our customers get more out of their investment. Digitalization solutions including collaborative operations and augmented reality help improve plant and enterprise productivity, reduce maintenance and energy costs. Our engineering, project management, services and solutions portfolio covers a wide range of industries - Pulp, Paper & Fiber, Mining, Gearless Mill Drives (GMDs), Hoists, Metals, Growth Industries such as Cement, Food & Beverage, Data Center Automation, High Power Rectifiers, and Batteries.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Engineering Manager - GMD

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will ensure the effective delivery of the Service portfolio according to ABB's standard processes and safety guidelines, ensuring customer satisfaction. Each day, you will provide technical support, act as a specialist, and solve problems within your area of expertise. You will also leverage your expertise by proactively communicating with both customers and ABB service sales and life cycle management teams to understand customer needs and capitalize on business opportunities for service growth. The role includes on-site assignments up to 40% of the time.

The work model for the role is: LI-Hybrid

This role contributes to the Business Line Mining & Materials in a global leadership role for the anchor product GMD (Gearless Mill Drive). Main stakeholders include customers, internal service sales and life cycle management teams, and other engineering disciplines.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Providing technical support and solving problems via remote or on-site service, including installation and commissioning, maintenance, repairs, trouble shooting, back-office engineering and consulting, retrofit engineering, etc.

  • Investigating customer needs through professional consulting. Additionally, managing customer relationships and maintaining regular contact with key customers and acting as 24/7 support line for one complete week, approx. every two months, depending on availability.

  • Proactively suggesting product and quality improvements and communicating them within the ABB organization.

  • Providing technical consulting on Service solutions to management and customers. You will join a truly international and dynamic team, where you will be able to thrive.

• Qualifications for the role

  • A bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering or any related field.

  • Proven experience as an electrical engineer, product specialist or in a similar technical role, preferably within the power electronics sector.

  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach with effective communication and relationship-building skills.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, enabling seamless collaboration across departments and with customers.

  • Attention to detail, ensuring product conformity, accurate technical documentation, and adherence to quality standard.

  • Fluency in English is required. Proficiency in other languages such as Spanish is a plus.

GREAT MINDS, GREAT MINES From cellphones, electric vehicles, batteries, wind farms…virtually every aspect of modern life relies on the ores mined from the earth. But there must be a transformation. Service Engineering Manager - GMD

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will ensure the effective delivery of the Service portfolio according to ABB's standard processes and safety guidelines, ensuring customer satisfaction. Each day, you will provide technical support, act as a specialist, and solve problems within your area of expertise. You will also leverage your expertise by proactively communicating with both customers and ABB service sales and life cycle management teams to understand customer needs and capitalize on business opportunities for service growth. The role includes on-site assignments up to 40% of the time.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Procurement Manager

__

As Project Procurement Manager, you will manage procurement execution for complex projects, ensuring the timely delivery of goods and services in compliance with contractual, quality, and schedule requirements.

Reporting to the Procurement & Logistics Team Lead, you will collaborate with Project Management, Engineering, Quality, Logistics, and suppliers to support effective project execution.

The working mode is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the AUPI Division in Switzerland.

Your main responsibilities will be:

  • Own end-to-end procurement execution for complex projects, ensuring the timely, compliant, and complete delivery of goods and services from global suppliers. Run supplier kick-offs, align expectations, establish effective communication frameworks, and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders to seamlessly integrate supplier deliverables throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Manage supplier performance, schedules, and quality to keep the project on track, continuously monitoring procurement progress, mitigating risks, expediting critical deliveries, resolving performance issues, and ensuring compliance with contractual requirements, quality plans, inspection and test plans (ITPs), and all project milestones.

  • Oversee commercial and contractual supplier management, negotiating project changes, variations, claims, back charges, and other contractual matters while safeguarding ABB's interests and ensuring the timely implementation of agreed actions and remedies.

  • Manage governance, documentation, and project reporting excellence, overseeing supplier documentation schedules and approvals, providing clear visibility on procurement status, risks, opportunities, supplier performance, and forecasted impacts, while ensuring successful purchase order closeout, fulfillment of contractual obligations, warranties, and final deliverables.

What we’re looking for:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

  • Several years of professional experience in project procurement, supply chain management, contract management within an international industrial environment.

  • Demonstrated experience in the execution of complex, multidisciplinary projects involving engineered equipment, global suppliers, and demanding schedule commitments.

  • Collaborative, initiative-driven, and solution-oriented personality with solid communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Well-developed analytical and organizational capabilities, with the ability to prioritize, carry out execution, and deliver results in demanding situations

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken; additional languages are welcome.

More about us:

Process Industries division delivers complete electrification and automation solutions, industry-​specific products and lifecycle services across industries. Understanding and addressing challenges and opportunities take a deep domain knowledge. Engineering and delivering automation solutions from device to monitoring and control make our customers get more out of their investment. Digitalization solutions including collaborative operations and augmented reality help improve plant and enterprise productivity, reduce maintenance and energy costs. Our engineering, project management, services and solutions portfolio covers a wide range of industries - Pulp, Paper & Fiber, Mining, Gearless Mill Drives (GMDs), Hoists, Metals, Growth Industries such as Cement, Food & Beverage, Data Center Automation, High Power Rectifiers, and Batteries.

The recruiting process is being led by Ceren Özen, Talent Acquisition Team Lead at ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

This position reports to:

EL Sales Supp. Mgr.-Configur.&Quotation

__

• Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten

In dieser Position spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle im Geschäftsprozess der ABB für Mittelspannungslösungen. Sie arbeiten eng mit Verkaufsteams, unseren Lieferanten und unseren Kunden während der Beratungs- und Ausschreibungsphasen zusammen.

Sie tragen direkt zur Qualität und Wettbewerbsfähigkeit unserer Angebote bei, indem Sie technische Expertise, kommerzielles Gespür und Ausführungsgenauigkeit kombinieren.

Arbeitsmodell: Hybrid

Diese Rolle trägt aktiv zur Entwicklung der installierten Mittelspannungsbasis bei unseren Kunden innerhalb der Division Distribution Solutions – ABB Electrification in der Schweiz bei.

• Ihre Hauptaufgaben

  • Angebotanfragen koordinieren und Einhaltung der Fristen während des gesamten Ausschreibungsprozesses sicherstellen

  • Lasten- und Pflichtenheft, technische Spezifikationen und Kundenanforderungen aus technischer und kommerzieller Perspektive analysieren und die am besten geeigneten Lösungen und Produkte basierend auf Kundenbedarf und Lösungsportfolio auswählen

  • Angebotsstrategien in Zusammenarbeit mit Vertriebs-, Ingenieur- und Projektmanagement-Teams definieren und Verhandlungen mit Lieferanten während der Angebotsphase führen

  • Kostenberechnungen durchführen und technische und kommerzielle Angebotsdokumentation strukturieren (Produktbeschreibungen, Services, Leistungen)

• Ihr Profil

Service Sales Support Manager

__

To strengthen our engineering team, we are looking for a dedicated, experienced Project Engineer. In this role, you take responsibility as a technical authority for electrical engineering projects with low to medium complexity – particularly for medium-voltage, low-voltage and standby power systems in the service business (retrofit). You implement the requirements of concepts within the specified time and budget framework and ensure that all specifications, quality standards, safety requirements and standards are consistently met.


Work Model: #hybrid
Business Line: Service (Division Electrification)

Your responsibilities

  • Product configuration, creation of electrical schematics using EPLAN and preparation of simple mechanical drawings using AutoCAD

  • Creation of selectivity calculations

  • Execution of type testing (design verifications) for non-standard configurations based on checklists and applicable standards

  • Technical support during tests and commissioning and support of project management in technical reviews, customer meetings and implementation of change and variation requests

  • Development of effort estimates and feasibility recommendations for the quotation team

  • Preparation of system documentation, as-built documents and acceptance records

• Qualifications for the Role

  • Completed apprenticeship as an electrician or automation technician plus further training as a technician HF/FH or comparable qualification

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in project engineering, ideally in energy technology. Experience in mechanical engineering is an advantage.

  • Very good CAD skills in EPLAN Electric P8; AutoCAD skills are an advantage

  • Technical understanding of the engineering of power supply systems (MV/LV/emergency supply power), ideally with experience with low-voltage switchgear

  • Strong focus on safe working practices and commitment to compliance with all relevant safety guidelines

  • Very high self-motivation as well as independent, solution-oriented and responsible working methods

  • Team player with a cooperative approach and good communication skills; you are fluent in German and English – French language skills are an advantage

This position reports to:

Marketing & Sales Manager

__

In this role, you will be responsible for driving front end sales for large and strategic mining projects, positioning ABB as a full-scope solution provider across the mining value chain. You will lead sales activities for complex international opportunities, covering the broader ABB portfolio in electrification, automation, drives and digital solutions, with an additional focus on the grinding portfolio.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to AUPI in Switzerland. Main stakeholders are Global Accounts, EPCMs and key Local Business Lines within AUPI.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Driving the sales of strategic mining projects, positioning ABB as a global solution provider.
  • Promoting and selling the full ABB portfolio for mining, including high voltage, medium voltage, low voltage, variable frequency drives, electrification, automation and digital solutions, with an additional focus on the grinding portfolio, including GMDs, RMDs and related applications.
  • Leading front-end sales activities for large, international mining opportunities with multiple stakeholders.
  • Managing capture teams and coordinating multinational and cross-functional resources towards a winning strategy.
  • Developing and executing account and opportunity strategies in close collaboration with account managers, OEMs, EPCMs and local ABB units.
  • Ensuring ABB’s value proposition is clearly communicated and professionally presented to customers and stakeholders.
  • Leading strategic discussions related to scope allocation and division of responsibilities between global and local units.
  • Building, qualifying and developing a strong pipeline of mining opportunities to support sustainable growth.

Our team dynamics

You will join a talented, high-performing and internationally connected team, where collaboration, business insight and customer focus are key to success.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Minimum 12 years of experience in the mining industry or similar, with a strong track record in sales or execution of complex industrial solutions.
  • Proven front-end sales leadership with capture team ownership in large strategic mining projects.
  • Specialist expertise in electrification, variable frequency drives, gearless drive systems and multi-megawatt power solutions.
  • Multi-megawatt drive systems experience; account strategy with EPCMs and OEMs.
  • Process-level understanding as mine owner's representative.
  • Established relationships with major mining accounts, major mine operators and EPCMs; technical authority in the market
  • Bachelor of Electrical & Electronics Engineering
  • Proven capture team leadership across 15+ countries; Solid writing and speaking skills in English & Spanish.

What’s in it for you?

  • Opportunity to shape ABB’s position in some of the world’s largest mining projects.
  • Exposure to global customers, EPCMs and ABB stakeholders across multiple countries.
  • A highly visible role with strategic impact on business growth.
  • The chance to work in an international environment with experienced sales and execution professionals.

More about us:

Process Industries division delivers complete electrification and automation solutions, industry-​specific products and lifecycle services across industries. Understanding and addressing challenges and opportunities take a deep domain knowledge. Engineering and delivering automation solutions from device to monitoring and control make our customers get more out of their investment. Digitalization solutions including collaborative operations and augmented reality help improve plant and enterprise productivity, reduce maintenance and energy costs. Our engineering, project management, services and solutions portfolio covers a wide range of industries - Pulp, Paper & Fiber, Mining, Gearless Mill Drives (GMDs), Hoists, Metals, Growth Industries such as Cement, Food & Beverage, Data Center Automation, High Power Rectifiers, and Batteries.

At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie mit, was die Welt regiert.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Marketing & Sales Manager

In dieser Rolle sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, den Front-End-Vertrieb für große und strategische Mining-Projekte voranzutreiben und ABB als Full-Scope-Lösungsanbieter in der gesamten Mining-Wertschöpfungskette zu positionieren. Sie leiten die Vertriebsaktivitäten für komplexe internationale Chancen, die das breitere ABB-Portfolio in den Bereichen Elektrifizierung, Automatisierung, Antriebe und digitale Lösungen abdecken, mit zusätzlichem Fokus auf das Schleifportfolio.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle lautet: #LI-Hybrid

Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

  • Förderung des Verkaufs strategischer Bergbauprojekte und Positionierung von ABB als globaler Lösungsanbieter.
  • Förderung und Verkauf des vollständigen ABB-Portfolios für den Bergbau, einschließlich Hochspannungs-, Mittelspannungs-, Niederspannungs-, variable Frequenzantriebe, Elektrifizierung, Automatisierung und digitale Lösungen, mit einem zusätzlichen Fokus auf das Schleifportfolio, einschließlich GMDs, RMDs und verwandte Anwendungen.
  • Führende Front-End-Vertriebsaktivitäten für große, internationale Mining-Möglichkeiten mit mehreren Stakeholdern.
  • Management von Capture-Teams und Koordination multinationaler und funktionsübergreifender Ressourcen für eine erfolgreiche Strategie.
  • Entwicklung und Ausführung von Account- und Opportunity-Strategien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Account Managern, OEMs, EPCMs und lokalen ABB-Einheiten.
  • Das Wertversprechen von ABB wird klar kommuniziert und Kunden und Stakeholdern professionell präsentiert.
  • Leitung strategischer Diskussionen im Zusammenhang mit der Zuweisung von Zuständigkeiten und der Aufteilung der Zuständigkeiten zwischen globalen und lokalen Einheiten.
  • Aufbau, Qualifizierung und Entwicklung einer starken Pipeline von Bergbaumöglichkeiten zur Unterstützung nachhaltigen Wachstums.

Unsere Teamdynamik

Sie werden Teil eines talentierten, leistungsstarken und international vernetzten Teams, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Business Insight und Kundenorientierung der Schlüssel zum Erfolg sind.

  • Bewährte Front-End-Vertriebsführerschaft mit Capture-Team-Besitz in großen strategischen Bergbauprojekten.
  • Spezialisiertes Know-how in den Bereichen Elektrifizierung, variable Frequenzantriebe, getriebelose Antriebssysteme und Multi-Megawatt-Stromlösungen.

  • Etablierte Beziehungen zu großen Bergbaukonten, großen Minenbetreibern und EPCMs; technische Autorität auf dem Markt
  • Bachelor of Electrical & Electronics Engineering
  • Nachgewiesene Teamführung in über 15 Ländern; Solide Schreib- und Sprachkenntnisse in Englisch & Spanisch.

  • Gelegenheit, die Position von ABB in einigen der größten Bergbauprojekte der Welt zu gestalten.
  • Exposition gegenüber globalen Kunden, EPCMs und ABB-Stakeholdern in mehreren Ländern.
  • Eine sehr sichtbare Rolle mit strategischen Auswirkungen auf das Unternehmenswachstum.
  • Die Chance, in einem internationalen Umfeld mit erfahrenen Vertriebs- und Ausführungsprofis zu arbeiten.

Mehr über uns:

Die Division Process Industries bietet komplette Elektrifizierungs- und Automatisierungslösungen, branchenspezifische Produkte und Lifecycle-Services in allen Branchen. Das Verständnis und die Bewältigung von Herausforderungen und Chancen erfordern ein tiefes Fachwissen. Engineering und Lieferung von Automatisierungslösungen vom Gerät bis zur Überwachung und Steuerung machen unsere Kunden mehr aus ihrer Investition. Digitalisierungslösungen einschließlich kollaborativer Operationen und Augmented Reality helfen, die Produktivität von Anlagen und Unternehmen zu verbessern, Wartungs- und Energiekosten zu senken. Unser Engineering-, Projektmanagement-, Service- und Lösungsportfolio deckt eine breite Palette von Branchen ab - Zellstoff, Papier & Fasern, Bergbau, Getriebelose Mühlenantriebe (GMDs), Hebezeuge, Metalle, Wachstumsbranchen wie Zement, Lebensmittel & Getränke, Data Center Automation, Hochleistungsgleichrichter und Batterien.

Dieser Rekrutierungsprozess wird von Ceren Özen, Talent Acquisition Team Lead Switzerland, geleitet.

Research Team Manager - Power Electronic Systems

__

Your role and responsibilities

Our team's mission is to drive innovation at the intersection of power electronic converters and electromagnetics, translating cutting-edge research into next-generation ABB products. We focus on electromagnetic modeling of power converter systems and components, conducted and radiat-ed emissions mitigation, passive and active filtering strategies, and shielding. By joining us, you will shape the future of energy systems — generating pioneering ideas at the frontier of academic research and industrial innovation, while developing transformative technologies that advance ABB's product portfolio.


Are you passionate about enabling a sustainable future through electromagnetics research in pow-er converter systems? We want to hear from you! A dynamic, international team is excited to wel-come you as our newest member. Together, we will push boundaries and make a lasting impact on the energy transition.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Pioneer innovative concepts for ensuring electromagnetic compatibility and interference compliance in high-power converters

  • Develop EMC models to predict and analyze electromagnetic compatibility and optimize electromagnetic design of circuits and systems

  • EMC measurements of conducted and radiated emissions of converters and HF characterization of components

  • Patent innovative solutions and demonstrate technology leadership through e.g., high-impact publications

  • Collaborate closely with ABB research centers, business units, and universities to transition research into real-world applications


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in electrical engineering, physics or related discipline with specialization in power electronics or electromagnetics

  • Deep technical expertise in:

    • EMC/EMI theory and solid theoretical background in electromagnetic modelling and field simulations

    • Power electronic converter topologies, filters, magnetics, and semiconductor switching devices

    • Simulation tools such as CST, COMSOL, ANSYS, SPICE circuit simulator (LTSpice, SIMetrix), Simulink

  • Hands-on laboratory skills in HF-electromagnetic measurements (conducted and/or radiated emissions), with a proactive, self-driven approach to designing, building, and testing EMC/EMI-compliant power converters. Versatile skill set with the ability to bridge theory and practice across multiple technical domains.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced industrial research environment and deliver results

At the ABB Research Center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

  • Bachelor or Master's degree in Facility Management, Real Estate, Engineering, Business Administration or a related field.
